neutral_facts.correct_value: High Court allowed respondent's application and directed trial court to expedite; Supreme Court later set aside that order. Delay attributed by respondent to accused's tactics.

neutral_facts.reason: Wrongly says High Court dismissed the application; it directed expedition. Also presents delay cause as settled fact.

offence_severity.reason: Severity not graded in the judgment.

number_of_offences.reason: Charged sections correctly listed; no conviction, so final upheld is not stated.

financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment does not discuss any loss; 'Not applicable' asserts more than the text supports.

motive.reason: No motive identified in the judgment.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: criminal trial where offences involved are under the Prevention of Corruption Act have to be conducted and concluded at the earliest
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Judgment discusses no evidence; the value restates a legal principle as evidence.

witness_credibility.quote: Respondent No.2 is in no way connected with initiation of criminal proceeding
witness_credibility.reason: No witnesses or credibility assessment; the locus finding is misplaced here.

trial_duration.reason: 23.05.2020 is the charge-sheet date, not a trial judgment; trial is not concluded.
